notes: Per-spec leveling reservations (sim-accuracy round 10). Below 60 a band's talent build is the guide's level-60 build cut down by the top-row-down walk (sim/leveling LadderTalentString). A spec listed here takes these ranks of its own tree first, in order, each once the build can legally hold it and never past the guide's own rank for that talent, then walks as before; so the ladder only ever adds points and its level-60 build is the guide's. A row is adopted only where the band builds it makes beat the plain walk's beyond error at seeds 1 and 50001 (10,000 iterations, the band's own heal profile, both factions), keep every talent the engine models only by a probe as zero, drop nothing the rotation casts and lose at no band. The evidence is in design/reviews/2026-11-03-sim-audit-round10/healprofile.md and design/reviews/2026-11-03-sim-audit-round11/healprofile.md. sim/leveling embeds a copy (make ladder-first-sync); TestEmbeddedLadderFirstMatchesCurated holds it to this file. An order-only row (owner, 2026-11-04) moves no published band: where the bands tie, real leveling play decides the order, and its reason says why in one line.

druid-feral.reason: The plain walk spends Savage Fury at 23 and 24 while Sharpened Claws (3% crit a point in Cat Form) waits for 26, and Predatory Discipline, which only changes Ferocious Bite (the cat Bites little before raid gear, and the ladder's bare fight never does), at 31 ahead of Leader of the Pack, Blood Frenzy, Natural Instinct and Rend and Tear. This order takes Shredding Attacks at 20 to 22 (its first point does nothing alone, but taking Sharpened Claws first at 20 costs 1.9 to 3.0% at 21 and 22, where the second point makes Shred the builder), Sharpened Claws at 23 and 24, Feral Charge at 25 (in Forever it is also a Cat Form leap behind the target, the only way a solo cat Shreds a mob that faces it), Savage Fury, Predatory Strikes, then Leader of the Pack, Blood Frenzy, Natural Instinct and Rend and Tear, with Predatory Discipline at 39 to open Shifting Power. Bare band 20 and 30 gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: 23 +1.4%, 24 +2.7%, 26 +1.3%, 31 to 33 +3.0 to 3.4%, 34 and 35 +0.7 to 0.9%, 36 to 38 +0.5%; levels 20, 25, 27 to 30 and 40 do not change (sim-accuracy round 28, hybrids lane).

druid-feral-bear.reason: The rotation casts Lacerate (the 15-point row, rank 1 at 25, behind Savage Fury 2) and Primal Bite (the 30-point row, rank 1 at 40, behind Leader of the Pack). A level 30 druid's 21 points hold Lacerate and a level 40 druid's 31 hold Primal Bite, but the plain walk spends them on Shredding Attacks and Blood Frenzy. Taking each as soon as it fits raises threat on the tank fight beyond error at bands 20 (Savage Fury's first rank for Feral Swiftness's, about 5%), 30 (about 41%) and 40 (about 19%), both factions, seeds 1 and 50001 (sim-accuracy round 13, hybrids); damage taken rises about 1 to 2% without the dodge points. Bands 50 and 60 already carry both and do not change.

druid-restoration.reason: On each band's own fight, Restoration levels better with Heart of the Wild, all three ranks of Reflection and Bloom ahead of the top rows' other points, and Nature's Swiftness held as soon as it can be: beyond error at band 20 (round 11's pull profile, both factions) and band 30 (round 10), and no band loses. Sim-accuracy round 29 (walks-heal): the list is now the whole order. Nature's Focus 3 to 5, Naturalist and Tranquil Spirit took 21 to 39 while Gift of Nature, Improved Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, Living Spirit and Genesis waited, and Nature's Swiftness's reservation pulled all five Naturalist points ahead of them; Nature's Splendor came last at 60. Now Bloom 20, Nature's Focus 21, Genesis 22, Gift of Nature 23 to 25, Improved Rejuvenation and Swiftmend by 29, Living Spirit 31 to 33, Genesis to 38, Nature's Majesty, Moonglow and Nature's Splendor by 44 (a Balance talent behind its own rows), then Improved Regrowth, Improved Tranquility, Tranquil Spirit and Naturalist, and Nature's Swiftness last at 60. Effective healing on each band's own fight, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: level at 21, +0.0 to +1.6% at 22 to 29, +6.6 to +9.3% at 30 to 39, +7.5 to +14.4% at 40 to 49, +5.4 to +8.3% at 50 to 59.

hunter-beast-mastery.reason: Order only (owner, 2026-11-04; sim-accuracy round 15, hunter): Focused Fire, 2% more damage for you and the pet, opens at 15 and outvalues the last Endurance Training points (pet health and armor) on every pull from 15 to 18; the published bands hold the same points either way.

hunter-survival.reason: The rotation casts Strider Kick (the 20-point row, learned at 30). A level 30 hunter's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Predator's Edge's fifth rank. Taking Strider Kick as soon as it fits gains about 10% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane); the other bands do not change. Lacerating Strikes, the walk's own capstone from 40, is held after it so the reservation never costs it. Predator's Edge is held at 25 to 29 and Resourcefulness, Expose Prey, Survivalist's Discipline and Lightning Reflexes's first point after Strider Kick, ahead of Deterrence and Counterattack, which come at 38 and 39 to pay Lacerating Strikes's toll: Deterrence is never pressed and Counterattack needs a parry, which a target hitting someone else (or your pet) never gives. Bare band 20 and 30 gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: 25 to 29 +1.3 to 1.5%, 30 +1.5%, 31 +2.0 to 2.5%, 32 to 35 +4.9 to 5.7%, 37 +4.0%, 38 +0.7% (sim-accuracy round 28, hybrids lane).

mage-arcane.reason: The rotation casts Arcane Blast (the 10-point row, learned at 20). The plain walk spends level 20's eleventh point on Arcane Resilience's armor and reaches Arcane Blast only at 27. Taking Arcane Concentration's five ranks and then Arcane Blast as soon as they fit puts Blast at 20 in place of that armor point: +0.2% at band 20 and +17 to +21% at 25, at seeds 1 and 50001, both factions; the other bands do not change (sim-accuracy round 15, mage wave 2).

mage-fire.reason: The level 60 build carries Accelerant 5/5 and Burning Soul 2/3 (sim-accuracy round 23, from the raid build's +2.3% at bare 60), and the plain walk spends Accelerant's first-row ranks at 16 to 19, ahead of Ignite, which puts Pyroblast at 20 but Heating Up at 33 and Combustion at 43 (band 30 about -13%, 40 about -6%). This list keeps the old order for everything the rotation casts: Incineration 5, Accelerant 1, Ignite 4, Pyroblast at 20 (sim-accuracy round 13: about +2% at band 20 over Ignite's fifth rank), Ignite 5, then Accelerant 2 to 4 at 22 to 24 in place of Flame Throwing and Burning Soul (a faster Fireball, your filler below 30), Improved Fire Blast, Improved Scorch, Heating Up at 30, Master of Elements, Critical Mass, Fire Power and Combustion at 40; Accelerant 5 and Burning Soul 2 follow at 41 to 43. Against the old ladder at 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: +0.7 to +1.0% at 22, +1.4 to +2.7% at 24 and 25, +0.8 to +1.0% at 27, +1.4 to +1.6% at 50, +1.5 to +1.8% at 57, +2.3 to +3.8% at 60; 10, 20, 30, 35, 38, 40, 45 and 55 unchanged. Levels 41 to 43 lose 0.2 to 0.6% (Wand Specialization moves from 41 and 42 to 44 and 45: the walk spends the own tree first); no checkpoint loses.

mage-frost.reason: Frost casts Frostbolt from level 4: Improved Frostbolt 10 to 14 (+2.0 to +2.9% at band 10, round 15). Then Precision 15 to 17 before Frost Warding, which only adds armor; Ice Shards 18 and 19 open the row for Frost Channeling at 20 to 22, the mana that keeps Frostbolt going; Ice Shards ends at 25; Frostbite 26 lets Shatter (27, 28) work on frozen mobs; Ice Lance 29 opens Fingers of Frost at 30 and 31, six levels sooner, and Shatter ends at 32. Frost Warding, Permafrost, Ice Block and Cold Snap fill 33 to 37, and Ice Barrier still comes at 40. Bare, band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: level 15 +2.4%, 16 +4.8 to +4.9%, 19 +0.7 to +0.8%, 20 +2.5 to +2.8%, 22 +7.8 to +8.9%, 25 +7.5 to +8.3%, 29 +2.4 to +2.7%, 30 +6.2 to +6.4%, 32 +14.5%, 36 +6.1 to +6.4%; every level from 15 to 36 gains at both seeds (sim-accuracy round 28, casters lane).

paladin-holy.reason: On band 30's own fight, Oath of Light ahead of Infusion of Light's second rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions (sim-accuracy round 11). The plain walk also spends Holy points a healer cannot use while live ones wait: at band 20 the 11th point goes to Purifying Power (Cleanse cost and the Exorcism and Holy Wrath cooldowns, none of which the healer casts) instead of Illumination, and at band 30 the 19th goes to Divine Precision (Holy spell hit; heals cannot miss) instead of Infusion of Light's second rank. Illumination's first rank, Divine Favor (which the rotation casts), Illumination to four ranks, Oath of Light, Illumination's fifth rank and both ranks of Infusion of Light, in that order, raise band 20's effective healing about 3.5% on its own fight, both factions, seeds 1 and 50001, hold band 30 level, and leave bands 35 to 60 on the plain walk (sim-accuracy round 15, paladin). The order keeps every level's build a superset of the level before (the walk takes the longest legal prefix) and still takes Oath of Light at 25. Sim-accuracy round 29 (walks-heal): Reverence at 15 and 16 before Healing Light, Illumination 20 to 24 before Divine Favor (now 30), Divine Intellect 26 to 29 and 31 before the dead tolls, Benediction and Conviction (6% crit) 32 to 39, then Purifying Power, Divine Precision and Infusion of Light only as Holy Shock's toll, Holy Shock at 45 (in a leveling dungeon it costs more mana than it returns until Holy Power is behind it), Boundless Light, Holy Power by 52, Light's Vigil 53, and Precision, Guardian's Favor and Sacred Duty, which do nothing for a healer, last. +1.3 to +10.8% at 15 to 18, +1.5 to +2.7% at 21 to 25, +0.2 to +4.6% at 26 to 40, +8.7 to +15.7% at 43 to 58, +4.3% at 59, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions; at 41 and 42 a Human ties or trails by 0.5% until the tank's Flash of Light row follows the new talents (rank-choices.json, round 29).

paladin-protection.reason: Holy Shield, which the rotation casts from rank 1 at 30, sits on the 21-point row; a level 30 paladin's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the 21st on Improved Righteous Fury. Taking Holy Shield as soon as it fits (and Shieldsworn as soon as it fits, the capstone the spine already gave band 40) raises band 30's threat beyond error on the tank fight, both factions, seeds 1 and 50001 (sim-accuracy round 12, hybrids); damage taken rises about 2% with the Improved Righteous Fury point gone. No other band changes. Templar's Bulwark (the 10-point row, no level gate since the 70707 hotfix) is reserved ahead of them by owner ruling (first, because the walk takes the longest legal prefix of the list and Holy Shield cannot fit below 30) (sim-accuracy round 14): at band 20 it takes the second Sacred Duty point, which shortens only Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Bulwark itself. On the tank fight chance of death falls from about 77% to 66% for about 2% less threat; survival wins for a tank at this band, a stated exception to the threat metric that is not generalised to other bands or specs. Bands 25 and up already hold Bulwark and do not change. Shield Specialization (a block returns 4% mana) is held at 21 and 22 ahead of Sacred Duty's second point, and Swift Judgement (a second Judgement, from the 15-point row) at 25, the first level the row opens, ahead of Toughness's last four points, which only add armor. Tank fight, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: threat at 21 and 22 +2.3 to 3.2% with chance of death no higher, 25 to 28 +5.2 to 6.2%; levels 20, 23, 24 and 30 do not change (sim-accuracy round 28, hybrids lane).

priest-discipline.reason: On band 20's own fight, Meditation ahead of Mental Agility's first rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; on band 30's, Penance (which the rotation casts) ahead of Soul Warding does too; no other band changes. Sim-accuracy round 29 (walks-heal): Meditation 20 to 22 (it was 20, 28 and 29), Inner Focus, Mental Agility and Improved Power Word: Shield to Penance at 30, then Improved Renew 31 to 33 and Soul Warding, Twilight Focus 35 to 37 and Holy Specialization 38 to 42 before Renewed Hope and Divine Aegis (43 to 49), Divine Fury, Improved Healing 54 to 56 and Inspiration last. +6 to +15% at 21 to 28, +0.2 to +4.9% at 31 to 48, +1.9 to +6.1% at 54 to 59 (3,000-iteration sweep, Horde seed 1; the 10,000-iteration cells are in the round's report).

priest-holy.reason: Prayer of Mending, which the rotation casts, is the Holy tree's deepest talent; the plain walk leaves it out at band 40. Taking it there, with Spiritual Healing's three ranks taken as soon as they can be held (ahead of Spiritual Guidance's last ranks), beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; no other band changes. Sim-accuracy round 29 (walks-heal): Improved Renew 10 to 12 and Holy Specialization 13 to 17 before Twilight Focus, Divine Fury 18 and 19, Inspiration 20 to 22, Twilight Focus 23, 24 and 29, Holy Binding 25 (its Flash Heals heal the priest too), Improved Healing 26 to 28, Litany of Light, Spiritual Guidance to 4, Spirit of Redemption and Spiritual Healing by 39, so all thirty Holy points are in for Prayer of Mending at 40 with Divine Fury's last three points held back; from 41 Twin Disciplines, Mental Strength, Meditation by 53 (Discipline talents behind their own rows), Inner Focus, Mental Agility, and Divine Fury 58 to 60. +0.8 to +7.9% at 10 to 19, +0.1 to +0.7% at 20 to 24, +9.3 to +15.5% at 25 to 31, +1.1 to +8.0% at 32 to 59, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions.

priest-shadow.reason: Wand Specialization 2/2 at 10-11, then Spirit Tap 5/5, the order every Forever guide that orders them gives (Icy Veins Forever Shadow leveling https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/shadow-priest-leveling, 2026-11-02: 'Your first priority is to pick up Wand Specialization'; Kargoz's Forever 1-60 guide on Mobalytics). The wand is 37 to 41% of a leveling priest's damage on the band fight: +10.1% at band 20 and +5.7% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001. A ladder only adds points, so Shadowform moves from 40 to 42 (band 40 -36%); a priest spends thirty levels before 40 and two after it, and the guides take the same trade (sim-accuracy round 15 wave 6, an owner call the lane decided). Spirit Tap changes no number on the band fight (no kills). Shadow Focus, Improved Mind Blast, Improved Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay and Improved Mind Flay follow ahead of Blackout, which the band fight does not model, so band 30 holds Improved Mind Flay (+5.9% alliance, +4.8% horde over the Wand-first walk's band 30, which lacked it and lost 1.8 to 2.4%). Mind Flay is not reserved: on the band-20 fight a rank-1 Mind Flay loses to wanding (the fight runs out of mana), so it lands at 28.

rogue-assassination.reason: The rotation casts Mutilate (the 30-point row since client 1.60.1.70755, behind Venom, learned at 40). The plain walk never reaches Venom on the way down, so Venom and then Mutilate are taken as soon as each fits: Venom at 29, where it also makes every Shank raise your poisons, and Mutilate at 40. Before 70755 Mutilate sat on the 20-point row and was taken at 30 for about 8% at band 30 (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Malice 5 at 10 to 14, then Ruthlessness 3, Improved Slice and Dice 2 and Lethality 2, come ahead of Improved Gouge and Remorseless Attacks: the rotation never casts Gouge and Remorseless Attacks needs a kill, so neither does anything in a fight. +1.3% at level 10, +6.7% at 14, +3.0% at 20, +0.3% at 25, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions; the order rejoins the old one at 28 (sim-accuracy round 27, orders lane; wowfdb.com and wowforevercompass.com Forever Assassination leveling orders open Malice 10 to 14).

rogue-combat.reason: Precision (+1% hit a point) at 15 to 17 and Puncturing Wounds (Backstab crit) at 18 to 20 come ahead of Lightning Reflexes past the one point the 5-point row toll needs, since its dodge does nothing while the target hits someone else; Lightning Reflexes finishes at 21 to 24, where the order rejoins the old one; Adrenaline Rush stays at 40, as the plain walk takes it. Bare, band 20 dagger, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: level 15 level (Precision's first point is lost to the level-gap hit penalty), 16 +1.0%, 17 +2.1%, 18 +5.5%, 20 +5.5%, 22 +2.2%; with a sword Precision first gains 2.1% at 17 and 2.9% at 20 while Puncturing Wounds gains nothing, so Precision leads (sim-accuracy round 27, orders lane).

rogue-subtlety.reason: The rotation casts Premeditation (the 10-point row since client 1.60.1.70755), Ghostly Strike (the 15-point row) and Hemorrhage (the 20-point row, behind Serrated Blades 3). They are reserved in tier order, Elusiveness's first rank ahead of Ghostly Strike because the engine does not model it (Vanish is never cast), so every level only adds points. On the 70753 trees the reservation gained about 2.6% at band 20 and 6.7% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Initiative (a combo point on every Garrote, cast after each Ghostly Strike) is held from 24, two points before Ghostly Strike and the third after it, in place of Camouflage and Elusiveness, which only pay the row tolls: +0.4% at level 25 and +1.0% at level 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 26, melee lane). Opportunity (+4% a point to Backstab, Garrote and Ambush) is held first, at 10 to 14, ahead of Master of Deception, which only helps sneak past mobs: level 10 ties with the band's mace and gains 1.4% with a dagger, level 14 +0.5% and level 15 +0.3%, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 27, orders lane).

shaman-enhancement.reason: The rotation casts Stormstrike, which sits in the 15-point row. Its spell is a level 40 spell, but the talent teaches it whenever the row is open: beta logs (foreverlogs.gg reports 2712, 2717, 2753, 2805) show Enhancement shamans of level 25 to 35 casting it. The plain walk spent a level 30 shaman's 21 points on Flurry's fourth rank instead; holding Stormstrike as soon as it fits takes that point and gains about 25% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 15, shaman lane). Rage of the Farseer (the 30-point row, used on cooldown) is held next so band 40 keeps the plain walk's point in it; bands 40 to 60 already carry both and do not change.

shaman-restoration.reason: On band 20's own fight, Mindfulness's second rank ahead of Tidal Focus's last rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions (round 11); Water Shield, which the rotation casts, taken as soon as it can be held (ahead of Tidal Focus's fourth rank) beats that beyond error at band 20 too, both factions (round 12); no other band changes. Mana Tide Totem (the 15-point row), which the rotation casts, is held next: at band 30 it takes Tidal Mastery's point and gains about 1.9% effective healing, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane); Nature's Swiftness and Riptide at 30 and 40 measured lower or under 1% and are not reserved. Sim-accuracy round 29 (walks-heal): Tidal Focus 10 to 12 before Improved Healing Wave (a faster Healing Wave at these levels only spends the mana sooner), Mindfulness 15 to 17, Water Shield 20, Improved Healing Wave full at 23, Mana Tide Totem 25, Restorative Totems 26 to 29 and 33, Healing Way 30 to 32, one point of Tidal Mastery, Purification 35 to 39 and Riptide at 40; Ancestral Knowledge and Thundering Strikes 41 to 50, then Tidal Mastery, Nature's Swiftness 55, Ancestral Healing and Healing Focus last. +0.2 to +17.8% at 10 to 22, +2.3 to +24% at 26 to 49, +0.6 to +3.6% at 50 to 59 (3,000-iteration sweep, Horde seed 1; the 10,000-iteration cells are in the round's report).

warlock-affliction.reason: The rotation casts Siphon Life (the 20-point row, learned at 30). A level 30 warlock's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Pandemic. Taking Siphon Life as soon as it fits gains about 1.3% at band 30, beyond error at seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Wrack, the walk's own capstone from 40, is held after it so the reservation never costs it.

warlock-demonology.reason: The rotation casts Soul Link before the pull (the 20-point row, behind Demonic Sacrifice). A level 30 warlock's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Decimation's second rank, which does nothing before Soul Fire at 48. Taking Soul Link as soon as it fits gains about 2.3% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Demonic Sacrifice is not reserved: the rotation never casts it without Demonic Pact, and at 20 it could only replace Demonic Aegis, which the engine does not model; the walk reaches it on its own by 30. Unholy Power (pet damage) 10 to 14 and Fel Vitality (mana) 15 to 17 come before Improved Health Funnel and Demonic Embrace, which do nothing in a fight (the rotation never casts Health Funnel, and Stamina deals no damage); Demonic Energies follows at 18, the old order rejoins at 25, and Demonic Knowledge 31 to 33 comes before Decimation's second point, which does nothing before Soul Fire at 48. Bare, band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: level 10 +0.14%, 15 +0.9 to +1.1%, 20 +0.4 to +0.7%, 23 +0.2%, 24 level (two dead points traded), 31 to 33 +3.1 to +3.3% (sim-accuracy round 28, casters lane).

warlock-destruction.reason: Destructive Reach (range) and Molten Skin (damage taken) do nothing in a fight, so they wait until a deeper row needs their points: Bane 10 to 14, Aftermath 15 to 17, Cataclysm 18 and 19, Shadowburn 20, Ruin 21 to 24, Agonizing Flames 25 to 27 and Ruin 28, then Destructive Reach 29. Conflagrate eats Immolate and loses damage until Fire and Brimstone backs it (-0.5% at 34 with no Fire and Brimstone), so Bane of Havoc, the Incinerate toll, comes at 30, Conflagrate at 31, Fire and Brimstone 32 to 34 and Shadow and Flame 35 to 38, five levels sooner; Destructive Reach 39, Incinerate 40, Molten Skin 41 to 43, and level 44 is the guide build. Bare, band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: level 10 +1.0 to +1.6%, 14 +3.0 to +3.3%, 20 +2.3 to +2.5%, 27 +7.4 to +7.8%, 30 +5.3%, 33 +0.4 to +0.6%, 38 +14.1 to +14.3%, 40 +11.5 to +11.6%, 42 +3.7%; every level from 10 to 42 gains at both seeds (sim-accuracy round 28, casters lane; Icy Veins and Warcraft Tavern Forever Destruction pages also open on Bane and take Destructive Reach later).

warrior-arms.reason: The rotation casts Mortal Strike (the 30-point row, learned at 40, behind Sweeping Strikes). A level 40 warrior's 31 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Weaponmaster. Taking Mortal Strike as soon as it fits gains about 20% at band 40, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Improved Overpower is held first, from 15: Overpower is cast from 12, while the walk's Improved Tactical Mastery only keeps rage through a stance change, which the rotation makes only for Recklessness from 50; +3.3% at level 20, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 26, melee lane). Before that, Improved Rend 3 at 10 to 12 and Improved Heroic Strike at 13 come ahead of Deflection, whose parry does nothing while the target hits someone else; its first point at 14 pays the toll for Improved Overpower: +0.9 to 4.9% at levels 10 to 17, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions, and level 20 unchanged (sim-accuracy round 27, orders lane; Mobalytics Forever Arms guide, 5 Nov 2026, also opens Improved Rend 10 to 12).

warrior-fury.reason: The rotation casts Death Wish (the 20-point row). A level 30 warrior's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Enrage. Taking Death Wish as soon as it fits gains about 3.8% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Bloodthirst, the walk's own capstone from 40, is held after it so the reservation never costs it.
